title: 第17章 热闹第18章 剧情杀
slug: 老师是个多周目速通玩家
lines: 你可能会好奇。
为什么龙墓盆地里都炸了锅了，密大学院的执事团还敢硬着头皮扎进来喂龙。
而真相其实是，他们在炸锅之前就进入龙墓了。
就因为这帮人的追踪能力太强，职业素养太过专业，加上还带着雾这个人肉导航，从迷魅森林出发之后就直接摸进了龙墓盆地，在不熟悉地形的情况下依旧轻松地绕过危险地带。
但就在他们靠近龙墓腹地的时候，刚好珲伍最后一刀把老飞龙的血条爆空。
于是就有了眼下的地狱绘卷。
整座龙墓盆地的龙子龙孙全部双眼泛红，陷入极致的癫狂。
它们本就已经是退化了灵智退化了血脉的生物，嗜血狂暴的本能被最大程度地激发了出来。
这一路上，执事团见到了无数恐怖画面。
走地龙自相残杀都已成为常态，更多的是直接用利爪撕开自己的胸膛，以一种极度惨烈的方式进行了殉道。
而执事团也因此遭了殃。
狂暴化的龙族对自己本族同类尚且如此凶残，当它们发现龙墓之内混进来的人族时，便直接展开了血腥追杀。
在最开始，就有两名执事团成员在猝不及防的情况下被撕成了碎片。
其余人只能仓皇逃窜。
雾提供了死诞者的行踪，此刻他们别无选择，只能顺着死诞者的路线一条路走到黑。
至少死诞者现在还没死，说明他走的可能是一条活路。
雾和坤反正是吓懵了的。
在辛之墓群里他们虽然见识过异族浪潮汹涌袭来的画面，但那毕竟是远远瞥上一眼，说到底并没有跟妖鬼群发生正面冲突。
而与之相比，龙族当中较为强大的个体是可以长到几十甚至上百米的体格的，被这种生物在发狂的情况下追杀，自己的脑子几乎是一片空白的，充斥脑海的只有漫天的龙啸声。
“姐，我不想死…”
处在执事团队伍中间不停狂奔的坤这会儿脸都吓白了。
雾与他并肩狂奔，且一句话都没有说，一只手紧攥着坤的衣服没有松开。
所幸，一行人最终是顺着雾的指引，顺利逃进了珲伍和宁语逃窜的那座谷底。
进入到这片区域之后，大型的走地龙就进不来了。
但还是有无数小型的走地龙钻过岩层的缝隙追杀了进来，不过那些孱弱的个体就无法对擅长搏杀的执事团造成太大威胁，闯进来的都被悉数斩杀。
饶是如此，执事团成员身上也都挂满了伤痕，只不过因为他们穿的都是黑色制服，即便被鲜血浸透也看不出狰狞，但是他们很多人脚下长靴踩过的地面都留下了血色脚印……
闯入谷底的众人终于是得到了片刻喘息的机会。
大部分人手持冷兵器守住了谷底入口的岩层缝隙，而执事团领队却对着黑漆漆的谷底深渊犯了难。
前方看起来像死路。
最重要的是，身为执事团领队，他本人对龙墓盆地那些鲜为人知的秘密多少是知道一点的。
他知道龙墓最凶险的并不是地表，真正造成龙族如今这幅衰败景象的东西，在地底下。
从这儿下去，是逃离了群龙的追杀没错，但不好说是不是跳进了一个更令人绝望的险地。
雾故意攥紧了留有刀痕的那只手掌，仔细感知着痛觉和血液的指引，最后认真地道：
“他就在下面。”
现场所有人都没有出声。
content_en:
You may be curious.
Why is it that even though the Dragon Tomb Basin is exploding, the deacons from the University of Michigan dare to bravely dive in to feed the dragon.
The truth is that they entered the Dragon Tomb before the frying pan.
Just because this group of people had such strong tracking ability, professionalism, and the human navigation system of Wu, they went directly into the Dragon Tomb Basin after setting off from the Enchanted Forest, and they could easily bypass the dangerous zone even though they were not familiar with the terrain.
But just as they were approaching the hinterland of the Dragon Tomb, Hui Wu's last blow emptied the old flying dragon's health bar.
Hence the present Hell Scroll.
All the dragon sons and grandsons in the Dragon Tomb Basin had their eyes turned red and fell into extreme madness.
They were already creatures with degraded intelligence and bloodline, and their bloodthirsty and violent instincts were stimulated to the greatest extent.
Along the way, the deacons saw countless horrific scenes.
It has become normal for earth dragons to kill each other, and more often than not, they directly tear open their own chests with their sharp claws and commit martyrdom in an extremely tragic way.
And the deacons suffered as a result.
The violent dragons were so cruel to their own kind. When they discovered the human race sneaking into the dragon tomb, they directly launched a bloody pursuit.
At the very beginning, two members of the deacon team were torn into pieces by surprise.
The rest of the people could only flee in panic.
The fog provided the whereabouts of the Deadman. At this moment, they had no choice but to follow the Deadman's route until they reached darkness.
At least the dead man is not dead yet, which means that he may be taking a way to survive.
Wu and Kun were stunned anyway.
Although they had seen the scene of the surging waves of alien races in the Tombs of Xin, it was only a glimpse from a distance. In the final analysis, they did not have a head-on conflict with the demons and ghosts.
In comparison, the more powerful individuals among the dragons can grow to tens or even hundreds of meters in length. Being chased by such creatures in a frenzy, his mind is almost blank, and the only thing that fills his mind is the roar of dragons all over the sky.
"Sister, I don't want to die..."
Kun, who was running wildly in the middle of the team of deacons, turned pale with fright.
Wu ran side by side with him without saying a word, holding Kun's clothes tightly with one hand without letting go.
Fortunately, the group finally followed Wu's guidance and successfully escaped into the valley where Hui Wu and Ning Yu fled.
After entering this area, large ground-walking dragons will not be able to enter.
However, there were still countless small-scale walking dragons that chased them through the gaps in the rock formations. However, those weak individuals could not pose much threat to the deacons who were good at fighting, and all those who broke in were killed.
Even so, the members of the Deacon Corps are also covered with scars, but because they are all wearing black uniforms, they cannot look ferocious even if they are soaked in blood, but the ground where their boots have stepped has left bloody footprints...
The people who broke into the valley finally got a moment to breathe.
Most of the people held cold weapons to guard the cracks in the rock formations at the entrance to the valley bottom, but the leader of the deacon team faced the dark abyss of the valley bottom.
The road ahead looked like a dead end.
The most important thing is that, as the leader of the Deacon Team, he himself knows a little bit about the little-known secrets of the Dragon Tomb Basin.
He knew that the most dangerous thing about the Dragon Tomb was not the surface. What really caused the current decline of the Dragon Clan was underground.
By going down here, it was true that he had escaped the pursuit of the dragons, but it was hard to say whether he had jumped into a more desperate and dangerous place.
Wu deliberately clenched the hand with the knife mark, carefully felt the pain and the guidance of the blood, and finally said seriously:
"He's down there."
No one at the scene made a sound.
